xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5482: docs: P3 batch (operating guide, foreman, CI integrations, unpublished pages, proposal in nav, blog draft, small gaps)

plan.title: docs: P3 batch (operating guide, foreman, CI integrations, unpublished pages, proposal in nav, blog draft, small gaps)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Docs-only change across 22 Mintlify files (5 new or rewritten pages, 3 deletions, link lines, docs.json). lintProjectedSurface counts each two-segment doc path (guides/operating.mdx, features/swarm.mdx, ...) and each root file (docs.json, .mintignore) as its own subsystem; the real surface is one docs site. The issue bundles seven independent P3 gaps (G15 to G21) into one PR and allows a split only if large; 22 files stays under the 25-file limit, the items are independent and parallel, and they share one docs.json item and one validation item.

narratives.Problem: The 2026-11-17 feature inventory found seven docs gaps: no page on operating Overdeck (emergency stop, disk alerts, reload vs restart, restart hold, crash auto-resume, backups); a Swarm page that describes a removed design and omits the foreman protocol; no CI integrations page; three unpublished polyrepo pages, two of which document a nonexistent pan setup and one with broken examples; a proposal page in Reference (already fixed by PAN-5483); a stale blog draft; and missing docs for Settings, Markdown preview, Docs RAG, pan artifacts and AutoPreso.
narratives.Proposal: One docs PR: new guides/operating.mdx, integrations/ci.mdx, reference/settings.mdx and configuration/docs-rag.mdx; rewrite features/swarm.mdx around the foreman protocol; rewrite and publish configuration/progressive-polyrepo.mdx; delete configuration/setup-wizard.mdx, configuration/meta-repos.mdx and blog/standing-crew.mdx with redirects; add Markdown preview and AutoPreso sections to existing pages; link everything from related pages; one docs.json item for nav and redirects; one validation item. Every fact comes from the PRD's verified background, re-grepped at implementation time.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No source, CLI help, UI text, config schema or script changes (the bugs found are filed as PAN-5548, PAN-5549, PAN-5550, PAN-5551, PAN-5552, PAN-5553, PAN-5555)
- No changelog.d entry
- No documentation of pan artifacts (PAN-5553)
- No documentation of pan docs disable/enable session or project scope (PAN-5552)
- No mention of reload --force, flywheel.globally_paused or the unmounted Deacon banner
- No claim about what swarm mode Auto does
- No naming of an assignee for CodeRabbit follow-up issues (PAN-5548)
- No new or reused screenshots; no reuse of images/dashboard/settings-*.png or images/swarm/*.png
- No fixes to projects.mdx --issue-prefix, the projects.mdx PRD-generation claim, or the polyrepo.mdx .agent-template example (left to PAN-5503)
- No edits to developer docs (docs/FOREMAN.md, docs/DOCS-RAG.md, docs/MERGE-TRAIN.md)
- No change to reference/template-conversations.mdx or the Roadmap group (G19 already done by PAN-5483)
- No rewrite of the blog post for overdeck.ai
- No docs.json reordering or reformatting beyond single-line inserts
- No links to pages that do not exist on the branch (voice, permissions, desktop, costs pages from open sibling issues)
- No mint validate --fix and no mint@latest

autoDecisions.summary: Ship all seven gaps as one PR of 22 files
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue allows a split only if large; 22 files is under the 25-file plan limit, the items are independent so the work agent can parallelize, and all pages share one docs.json and one validation step.

autoDecisions.summary: G16: rewrite features/swarm.mdx and describe both parallel protocols without ranking them
autoDecisions.rationale: The current page describes a removed dispatcher design. A pan start work agent gets roles/work.md (gated pan swarm protocol) while the pan-foreman skill and docs/FOREMAN.md describe pan spawn workers as the default; the user page describes both rather than resolve an internal inconsistency. PAN-5502 is told the page is covered here.

autoDecisions.summary: G18: delete setup-wizard.mdx and meta-repos.mdx and redirect them
autoDecisions.rationale: pan setup does not exist and the pages copy an unbuilt plan; every true concept has a current home (Add-a-project dialog, pan project, context layers, symlink readonly repos). Mintlify serves pages outside the nav, so redirects keep old URLs working.
PAN-5483 (d0a8e822282) already moved reference/template-conversations into a Roadmap group; the validation item checks it stays there.

autoDecisions.summary: G20: delete blog/standing-crew.mdx and redirect to model routing
autoDecisions.rationale: It presents standing per-tier sessions, a blocking supervisor and tier promotion as shipped, which PAN-5471 established are not; it cites v0.43 and has an unresolved price marker; the overdeck.ai blog lives in another repo, so a rewrite here would publish nowhere.

autoDecisions.summary: G21: do not document pan artifacts
autoDecisions.rationale: share always fails, the printed /s/ link has no route, and no skill or role uses the command; filed as PAN-5553.

autoDecisions.summary: G17 page stays at integrations/ci.mdx in a new Integrations group in the Configuration tab
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names that path; .mintignore already excludes the code files in integrations/, and a separate group keeps the Configuration list scannable.

autoDecisions.summary: G21 placements: reference/settings.mdx, configuration/docs-rag.mdx, and sections in file-explorer and dashboard-views
autoDecisions.rationale: A Settings reference is reference material; Docs RAG is configured with config keys; Markdown preview and AutoPreso are features of existing pages that already mention them in fragments.
